name.zh-TW: 用戶管理：看懂這個畫面

title.zh-TW: 用戶管理負責帳號本身，不負責權限內容
title.en-US: User Management handles accounts themselves, not permission details

description.zh-TW: 從「系統管理 → 用戶管理」進來。這裡管的是「誰可以登入系統」：開帳號、調整基本資料、指派角色。至於某個角色能看到哪些功能、能不能刪資料，那是「角色管理」的範圍。要調整權限請到角色管理改角色，不要為了給權限而多開一個帳號。
description.en-US: You get here from "System Management → User Management". This page manages "who can log in to the system": creating accounts, updating basic information and assigning roles. Which features a role can see, or whether it can delete data, falls under "Role Management". To adjust permissions, change the role in Role Management; don't create an extra account just to grant permissions.

title.zh-TW: 這些欄位是即時篩選，不會重新查詢資料庫
title.en-US: These fields filter instantly without querying the database again

description.zh-TW: 五個條件之間是「而且」的關係，輸入的當下就在已載入的清單上過濾，所以不用按查詢鈕、也不會有等待。反過來說，篩選只看得到目前已載入的資料——如果覺得某個帳號應該存在卻找不到，先用右上角的「重新整理」重新取一次資料，再判斷是不是真的沒有。右側會顯示「找到幾筆／共幾筆」，數字對不上時就是還有篩選沒清掉。
description.en-US: The five conditions are combined with "AND", and the already-loaded list is filtered as you type, so there's no Search button to click and no waiting. On the other hand, filters can only see the data that's currently loaded. If you think an account should exist but can't find it, first use "Refresh" in the top-right corner to fetch the data again, then decide whether it's really missing. The right side shows "Showing X of Y"; if the numbers don't match, some filters are still applied.

title.zh-TW: 「登入狀態」和「帳號狀態」講的是兩件事
title.en-US: "Login Status" and "Account Status" mean two different things

description.zh-TW: 「帳號狀態」是管理者設定的：已停用代表帳號還在、資料也還在，只是不能登入。「登入狀態」是帳號實際的登入能力：「尚未綁定登入方式」代表帳號建好了但還沒啟用，這是新帳號的正常狀態，不是故障；「鎖定中」則是連續登入失敗被系統鎖住。標示為「系統預設」的帳號由系統建立，請不要拿來當一般使用者帳號。
description.en-US: "Account Status" is set by an administrator: "Disabled" means the account and its data still exist, but it can't log in. "Login Status" is whether the account can actually log in: "No Login Method" means the account has been created but not activated yet, which is normal for a new account, not a fault; "Locked" means the system locked it after repeated failed logins. Accounts marked "System Default" are created by the system; please don't use them as regular user accounts.

title.zh-TW: 後台只能改資料與角色，不能刪帳號也不能停用
title.en-US: The admin console can only edit details and roles, not delete or disable accounts

description.zh-TW: 這裡只有「檢視」和「編輯」。編輯頁能改的是電子信箱、姓名與角色；登入帳號建立後就不開放修改，帳號的停用狀態目前也不開放在後台變更——那牽涉到不能停用自己、系統預設帳號不可停用這類防護，後台這支端點沒有做，所以刻意不給改。要停用或刪除帳號，請循管道請系統管理員處理。
description.en-US: There are only "View" and "Edit" here. On the edit page you can change the email, full name and roles. The account can't be changed after it's created, and an account's disabled status can't be changed in the admin console for now either: that involves safeguards such as not being able to disable yourself and not allowing system default accounts to be disabled, which this admin endpoint doesn't implement, so changing it is intentionally not allowed. To disable or delete an account, go through the proper channels and ask the system administrator.
